# Trip Chikmagalur

> Curated Chikmagalur tour packages, stays, adventure activities, food guides, and travel itineraries for India's coffee country.

Trip Chikmagalur (Wanderlust_ckm) is a local travel agency offering Chikmagalur trips, homestays, trekking, waterfalls, jeep safaris, and coffee plantation experiences. Bookings happen on WhatsApp (+91 6363131585).

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of Chikmagalur tour packages and experiences.
- [Tour Packages](/chikmagalur-tour-packages): Curated 1–5 day Chikmagalur packages with stays and sightseeing.
- [Places to Visit](/places-to-visit-in-chikmagalur): Top destinations including Mullayanagiri, Hebbe Falls, Baba Budangiri, Kemmanagundi.
- [Places Explorer](/places): 5-day itinerary map with featured destinations.
- [Adventure](/adventure): Trekking, ziplining, ATV, jeep safari and adventure activities.
- [Stays](/stays): Trip Chikmagalur Resort and Trip Chikmagalur Villa — book with check-in, check-out and adults.
- [Trip Chikmagalur Resort](/stays/trip-chikmagalur-resort): Palm grove resort with pool and family amenities.
- [Trip Chikmagalur Villa](/stays/trip-chikmagalur-villa): Private villa with kitchen, living areas and group spaces.
- [Food](/food): Local Chikmagalur cuisine and food experiences.
- [Blog](/blog): 27 SEO guides — packages, resort, villa, Mullayanagiri, Hebbe Falls, monsoon trips, corporate outings.
- [FAQ](/faq): 30+ answers on package prices, stays, treks, booking via WhatsApp.
